name: TrainPushup
_intent: Push-ups under crushing gravity, seen in profile: a straight plank from head to heels on planted toes, palms flat a little wider than the shoulders; each rep drops fast and heavy until the chest is 0.25 above the floor, the elbows bending BACK along the ribs, a trembling 2-frame hold, a slow strained push to locked arms and a small settle.
_reference: push-up, 2 reps per 2.0 s loop; Rep at frames 15 and 45
